decision_snapshot_source: PACS-Full replay before committing its selected plan

definitions.latency_change_percent: Per-trace host-request latency ratios minus one, times 100.
definitions.program_gain: tPROG(CWDP) minus tPROG(Full) for single-page writes relocated by Full.
definitions.load_gain: Difference in predicted program start times for the same single-page writes.
definitions.candidate_gaps: Maximum minus minimum over writable destinations at the shared CWDP write prefix. Load uses max(channel ready, die ready).
definitions.gap_intervals: Bins are (previous bound, upper bound], with a separate exact zero bin.
definitions.completion_gains: All three allocation plans are re-evaluated with configured WL latencies on the same snapshot.
